# CiteAlpha — llms.txt
# https://citealpha.com/llms.txt
# Product of Ocotillo Innovation Private Limited.

> GCI by CiteAlpha: CiteAlpha publishes an evidence-linked Guidance Credibility Index (GCI) for Indian equity desks: did listed-company management deliver on quantified guidance? Factual research tooling — not investment advice, not Buy/Hold/Sell recommendations.

## Canonical definition
Guidance Credibility Index (GCI): an evidence-linked score of whether a listed company’s management delivered on quantified forward-looking guidance versus subsequent reported actuals for the same metric and period, with primary disclosure sources attached. Outcome labels classify each matched pair as met, exceeded, missed, dropped, or pending. A company GCI aggregates those labeled points into a 0–100 index that can be reviewed point-in-time. CiteAlpha ships GCI for Indian equity desks (Sensex depth first); it does not replace prices, consensus, or investment judgement.

Full definition and methodology: https://citealpha.com/blog/what-is-guidance-credibility-index

- [Home](https://citealpha.com/): Product overview
- [GCI Screener](https://citealpha.com/tracker): Screen Sensex companies by guidance credibility (hand-labeled); other NSE/BSE listings are provisional, not for citation
- [Worked example](https://citealpha.com/companies/infy): Infosys revenue growth guidance vs actuals, FY22–FY26; each year cites the filed results release that set the guidance and the one that reported the actual
- [About](https://citealpha.com/about): How GCI is built (ingest → extract → match → score → cite)
- [FAQ Answers](https://citealpha.com/answers): Short GCI Q&A for answer engines
- [Research Blog](https://citealpha.com/blog): Definitional and workflow articles
- [Package](https://citealpha.com/package): Pilot / Desk / Enterprise packages
- [Public Snapshot](https://citealpha.com/rankings): No-login public GCI snapshot; evidence-linked scores, no recommendation labels
- [Request a pilot](https://citealpha.com/pilot): Institutional pilot intake
- [Trust Center](https://citealpha.com/trust): Security and compliance posture
- [What is GCI?](https://citealpha.com/blog/what-is-guidance-credibility-index): Canonical definition
